narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms, a few with heavy rainfall affected portions of Vermont during the afternoon on July 21. A few storms trained across northern Franklin County, VT, leading to scattered flash flooding.
ev: Showers and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall trained across the affected area during the afternoon hours of July 21. Radar estimates and ground observations showed between two and four inches of rain fell, leading to scattered reports of flash flooding, most notably in the Enosburg Falls, VT area where Routes 105 and 108 were closed due to high water and road damage.
lsr: VT-108 from Hayes Farm Road to VT-105 (Main Street) is closed due to flooding
VT-105 (Main St) is closed due to flooding
VT-105 between Boston Post Road and Choquette Road is closed due to flooding
VT-105 from Richford to East Richford is closed due to flooding
